breakdown.description: The setup uses B32 elements, but the deck uses M3D8 elements.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt asked to use B32 elements, but the provided input deck specified M3D8 elements. The ground truth resolved this by making the input deck the authoritative source and instructing to use its exact content. The agent correctly generated the instruction to 'Create a file named membrane3.inp in the working directory with the exact content provided,' thus prioritizing the deck's M3D8 elements and resolving the inconsistency.

breakdown.description: The setup assumes that the primary nodal load acts in the global y-direction, but the deck applies the concentrated load in the global z-direction.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt stated the load acts in the global y-direction, while the input deck applied it in the z-direction. The ground truth prioritized the input deck's content. The agent's generated specification to use the 'exact content provided' correctly instructs the simulation agent to use the load definition from the input deck (z-direction), thereby resolving the conflict.
